notes: Notes: Treeline Glade. Some variable wind effect on surface in TL/ALP. Layer Notes: 118-95cm: Dec 31st = Spotty 2-3 mm SH; 55-45cm: Dec. 5th layer @ 45 cm. Stability tests column: 'CT11, RP @95cm' with free text 'x2 on Dec. 31st'; 'CT29, RP @77cm'. Wind Loading, Specifics and Stability fields blank. No temperature profile.
summary: Treeline glade pit (NE 20 deg, 2115 m, -14.5 C air): 4F+ base 0-25 cm, 1F 25-45, a P-hard 'Dec. 5th layer' at 45-55 (P) under P- 55-77, 1F 77-85, 4F+ 85-95 and soft F 95-118 cm deposited on the spotty Dec 31st SH at 95 cm; CT11 RP (x2) at 95 cm on the Dec 31 SH and CT29 RP at 77 cm; HS 118; PF 40, PS 20; no grain forms or temperatures drawn
reading_issues: Hardness bars and layer boundaries measured from pixels against the chart axes (boundaries 25, 45, 55, 77, 85, 95 cm). The form/size/moisture table is entirely blank, so every layer has grain null; the only grain information is in the layer notes (spotty 2-3 mm SH from Dec 31st at 95 cm). layer_grain for CT11 is SH from that note and the CT label ('on Dec. 31st'); the 'x2' is non-bold free text, recorded as count 2. CT29 RP at 77 cm sits on the 1F/P- boundary, layer_grain null. Layer note ranges '118-95cm' and '55-45cm' are placed as named layers at 95 cm and 45 cm (the stated '@ 45 cm' and the CT height). No temperature profile; surface-form row blank.
